source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: One time per battle, once an enemy unit has finished a Normal move, Advance move or [Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) move no more than 8″ away, this model may set off its Reductus mine: roll a D6, and if it shows 2+ the enemy unit takes D3+3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds). In any single battle round, no more than one of your models with this ability may use it. Designer's note: mark this with a Reductus Mine token beside the model and take the token away once the ability is used.

detail.designerNote: track with a Reductus Mine token
